title: A Noetherian complete local ring is a Nagata ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring which is complete, i.e. $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]: the canonical map $R\to\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ is bijective. Then $R$ is a Nagata ring [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring]: for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ the domain $R/\mathfrak p$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain].
